subject: Hosted API annualize and tier-roaming agreement
messages:
From: Mike Torres <mike.torres@edgewave.com>
To: rachel.kim@redwood.ai
Cc: finance@edgewave.com
Date: Mon, 15 Apr 2029 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal window — thinking about annualize + higher monthly commit

Rachel —

Thanks for the call today. We ran the usage export overnight and it looks like our monthly consumption is trending 22% above the committed tier we signed last year, mostly from an uptick in embeddings and some new internal search features. Finance wants to avoid persistent overages.

Two asks from our side:
- Can Redwood provide an annualized commit (prepay) option that drops our per-token rate by ~18% compared to current monthly rates?
- We also need a temporary burst band during sale spikes (approx 30% of current committed throughput) but want it to be roll-off after 6 months.

We'd like a short proposal and an updated SOW we can route to procurement by next Wednesday (4/24). Also attaching the usage CSV.

—Mike
Head of Platform Engineering
EdgeWave Inc

Attachments: EdgeWave_Monthly_Usage_Q1_2029.csv (csv)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Mike Torres <mike.torres@edgewave.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 16 Apr 2029 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal window — thinking about annualize + higher monthly commit

Mike —

Appreciate the export, that helps. Quick summary of how we can structure this so procurement has a clean path:

1) Annualized committed plan: convert your monthly commit to an annual prepay (12x) at a blended unit rate. I can offer a 17% discount on our hosted generation tokens and 18% on embeddings if you commit to a 12-month annualized capacity at the target uplift (looks like ~22% above current).

2) Tier-roaming / soft roaming: rather than hard rebanding immediately, we propose a staged tier-roam — for the first 3 months we allow a +30% burst band with soft throttles (grace overage where we delay throttling until sustained spike > 15 minutes). After month 3 we evaluate usage and either fold the burst into the committed baseline or sunset the band. This reduces sudden rate shocks and keeps latency SLOs intact.

3) Ops/SLAs: Kimberly will map the routing/fallback policies (region, model variant) and a 6-month monitoring plan. Vanessa will handle the billing cadence and onboarding for the annualized invoice and invoice proration.

I'll put together a short proposal and a draft SOW/redline for procurement by EOD Monday (4/22). If that timeline works, I need a quick confirmation on the target uplift (% committed increase) and whether finance prefers net-30 or upfront prepay terms.

Thanks —
Rachel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: RI_Renewal_Term_Summary_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: rachel.kim@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 17 Apr 2029 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal window — thinking about annualize + higher monthly commit

Looping in pricing to confirm numbers. Provisional calculator (high level):
- Current committed baseline: 4.2B tokens/mo (hosted gen + embeddings equivalent)
- EdgeWave observed: average 5.1B tokens/mo (22% uplift)

Proposed annualized commit: 4.9B tokens/mo committed (annual prepay, invoiced trimestrally) => 17% off generation unit, 18% off embeddings unit.
Additional temporary burst: +30% band available to EdgeWave for months 1–3 with soft-throttle grace; month 4–6 reduced to +15% while we review. Burst charges billed at a discounted overage rate (50% of on-demand mark).

Notes for contract team: include a clause for a one-time mid-year re-evaluation and a cap on cumulative overage billing for the first 3 months (so they don't fear runaway invoices). Also propose a DocuSign-ready SOW template.

—Ben
Director, Commercials
ben.carter@redwood.ai

Attachments: renewal-redline-v2.pdf (redline)

From: Mike Torres <mike.torres@edgewave.com>
To: rachel.kim@redwood.ai
Cc: finance@edgewave.com, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 21 Apr 2029 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal window — thinking about annualize + higher monthly commit

Rachel / team —

This looks good and aligns with procurement priorities. Two quick confirmations before I route:
1) EdgeWave agrees to the 4.9B tokens/mo annualized baseline (12-month prepay, invoiced quarterly). Finance prefers net-30 on the quarterly invoice rather than full upfront.
2) We accept the temporary burst structure: months 1–3 (+30% soft band with capped cumulative overage) and months 4–6 (+15% band), billed at the discounted overage rate.

Please go ahead and send the DocuSign-ready SOW + the updated invoice terms. Can you also add a short paragraph in the SOW describing the mid-year re-evaluation process and success metrics (latency < 150ms p95, ≤2 production errors per 10k requests, usage review checkpoint).

If we get the SOW by Tuesday (4/23) we can route to procurement same day.

—Mike
Head of Platform Engineering
EdgeWave Inc

Quoted attachments: renewal-redline-v2.pdf, RI_Renewal_Term_Summary_v1.xlsx
